interpretation: DPLR leads the single-seed endpoint, but its 0.42 percentage-point gain over static LoRA plus diagonal is small and not capacity matched. Basis mixing does not beat diagonal at this recipe. Exact rank 2 needs optimization diagnostics and hypernetwork LR tuning before judging the transform family.
next_experiment: Modest LR tuning for plain, diagonal, static LoRA plus diagonal and DPLR; smaller hypernetwork LR for exact as a diagnostic; longer matched-budget multi-seed confirmation before diffusion transfer.
